proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : 1 ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n := by
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico]
    <;> omega
  
  have h₂ : 1 ∣ n := by
    exact Nat.one_dvd n
  
  have h₃ : Nat.Coprime 1 (n / 1) := by
    have h₄ : n / 1 = n := by
      simp
    rw [h₄]
    -- We need to show that gcd(1, n) = 1.
    -- Since gcd(a, b) = gcd(a, b - a), we can use the property of gcd.
    -- Here, gcd(1, n) = gcd(1, n - 1) = 1.
    -- However, since 1 is a special case, we can directly use the fact that gcd(1, n) = 1 for any n.
    simp [Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one, Nat.gcd_comm]
    <;>
    (try omega) <;>
    (try
      {
        cases n with
        | zero => contradiction -- n cannot be zero since hn : 1 < n
        | succ n =>
          simp [Nat.gcd_eq_right_iff_dvd, Nat.dvd_one]
          <;>
          omega
      })
    <;>
    omega
  
  have h₄ : 1 ∈ properUnitaryDivisors n := by
    rw [properUnitaryDivisors]
    simp_all [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ico, Nat.div_eq_of_lt]
    <;>
    (try omega) <;>
    (try
      {
        cases n with
        | zero => contradiction -- n cannot be zero since hn : 1 < n
        | succ n =>
          simp_all [Nat.div_eq_of_lt]
          <;>
          omega
      })
    <;>
    (try
      {
        simp_all [Nat.div_eq_of_lt]
        <;>
        omega
      })
    <;>
    (try
      {
        omega
      })
  
  exact h₄
